summary: RELEASE-005's stale blocker is retired: `main` IS now branch-protected. Read-only `GET /repos/KyleQD/Tourify/branches/main/protection` returns 200 with strict required checks and full review/admin enforcement. Three enforcement gaps remain against RELEASE-005 acceptance criterion 3, and they cannot be closed from the agent lane. No branch-protection setting was changed.
completed: Retired the recorded `404 Branch not protected` baseline for `main`. Both STATE.md and RELEASE-005 still carry it; the live configuration is now: strict required_status_checks (10 contexts), required_approving_review_count 1, dismiss_stale_reviews true, require_last_push_approval true, enforce_admins true, required_linear_history true, allow_force_pushes false, allow_deletions false, required_conversation_resolution true.

Captured the exact required-check set and mapped each against RELEASE-005 acceptance criterion 3 (clean install, lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, production build, migration checks, service-role audit, security scan, critical E2E).

Established that three required checks are the actual merge blockers on PR #14: `Database Types` (FAILURE), `Lint And Build` (FAILURE), `E2E Tests (Playwright)` (CANCELLED). mergeStateStatus is BLOCKED, and nothing else contributes.
Established that the `Vercel` failure and the Advanced Security `CodeQL` failure do NOT block the merge, because neither is a required check.
next_steps: Decide whether to require the GitHub Advanced Security `CodeQL` gate. It is the only check on the PR carrying a security verdict (96 open alerts, 1 critical) and it is not required, so a security regression cannot block a merge today.

Decide whether to require `Dependency review` (already SUCCESS on this PR, and already configured with `fail-on-severity: critical`) and `Migrations And RLS Matrix` (Admin RLS CI, already SUCCESS on this PR). Both are running but unenforced.

Address the structural gap: production build, migration checks (`check:migration-validation`), and the service-role audit (`check:service-role-allowlist`) exist only as steps sequenced after `Typecheck` inside the single `Lint And Build` job, not as independent required checks. On this PR the `Typecheck` step failed and all of them were skipped - including `Build` - so the release gate produced no production-build evidence at all. Either split them into separate required jobs or accept the coupling explicitly; the release lane did not change this because the obvious remedy (`continue-on-error` / `if: always()`) would weaken the gate.
Note that `required_signatures.enabled` is false, so commits are not required to be signed or verified.
blockers: RELEASE-005 explicitly records 'Have the repository owner provision branch protection on main and record e2e.yml as a required check; do not change this from the local task', and this lane was dispatched read-only for this item. No protection setting was modified.
`E2E Tests (Playwright)` is CANCELLED on this PR. That is another lane's failure and was not investigated here, but it is a required check and therefore a merge blocker.
Hosted exact-SHA QA-003 certification, deployment evidence, approver, and rollback point remain outstanding and are unaffected by the protection posture.
